**8B.9 Research Note**

Verdict: **mixed, slightly positive on external crisis/alliance management, weaker on domestic political control and follow-through under resistance**. Biden’s team often used formal channels, alliances, and federal authority to preserve leverage and reduce escalation, but the 2024 record also shows major losses of control: campaign collapse, weak follow-through on politically sensitive cases, and some coercive or contested domestic responses.

**Positive**
- **Secretary Blinken’s meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu** | U.S. Department of State | 2024-05-01 | https://2021-2025.state.gov/secretary-blinken-s-meeting-with-israeli-prime-minister-netanyahu-4/ | Claim: Biden’s team pushed ceasefire diplomacy, hostage talks, humanitarian aid, and limits on conflict expansion to preserve U.S. leverage and keep a regional war from widening. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`, `8B.6`
- **US urged countries to pass messages to Iran against escalation** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-urged-countries-to-pass-messages-to-iran-against-escalation-state-dept-says-3555469 | Claim: The administration used diplomatic intermediaries to warn Iran off escalation and preserve off-ramps, a classic crisis-management move to protect U.S. influence and avoid a wider war. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`
- **Readout of Secretary of Defense Lloyd J. Austin III’s call with People’s Republic of China** | U.S. Department of Defense | 2024-04-16 | https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3742639/readout-of-secretary-of-defense-lloyd-j-austin-iiis-call-with-peoples-republic/ | Claim: Keeping military-to-military communication and theater-commander channels open helped preserve crisis stability with China rather than letting rivalry become unmanaged. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`, `8B.6`
- **Joint press statement on the signing of the Nuclear Consultative Group guidelines** | U.S. Department of Defense | 2024-07-11 | https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3835633/joint-press-statement-on-the-signing-of-the-nuclear-consultative-group-guidelin/ | Claim: The U.S.-ROK formalized consultation and nuclear-operation procedures, strengthening alliance discipline and reducing unilateral drift under a hard-security threat. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`, `8B.6`
- **President Joseph R. Biden, Jr. Approves Florida Emergency Declaration** | The American Presidency Project | 2024-10-07 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/president-joseph-r-biden-jr-approves-florida-emergency-declaration-8 | Claim: The White House rapidly coordinated FEMA and named a federal recovery coordinator after Hurricane Milton, showing quick redeployment of state capacity under crisis pressure. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`, `8B.7`
- **Justice Department Finds Civil Rights Violations in Phoenix Police Department and City of Phoenix** | U.S. Department of Justice | 2024-06-13 | https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix | Claim: Biden’s DOJ used formal investigation and public findings to discipline a subordinate institution, showing the regime could assert control through legal enforcement rather than mere rhetoric. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`, `8B.6`
- **CBP releases June 2024 monthly update** | U.S. Customs and Border Protection | 2024-07-15 | https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/national-media-release/cbp-releases-june-2024-monthly-update | Claim: After Biden’s border proclamation, southwest-border encounters fell sharply, showing a short-term response that moved a salient domestic pressure point in the intended direction. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`

**Negative**
- **Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns** | Associated Press | 2024-07-21 | https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/ | Claim: The debate collapse shattered confidence and forced an exit from the race, which is strong evidence that Biden’s political operation had lost effective control over its own durability objective. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`, `8B.7`
- **The final days: How Biden and his inner circle blew it** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-21 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/the-final-days-how-biden-and-his-inner-circle-blew-it-3528027 | Claim: Reuters describes strategic missteps, weak internal flow, and top-level dysfunction, which undercuts the idea that the ruling network was preserving its own objectives through disciplined management. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`, `8B.7`
- **US tracking nearly 500 incidents of civilian harm during Gaza war** | Reuters via The Guardian | 2024-10-30 | https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/30/civilian-harm-us-weapons-israel-gaza-war | Claim: U.S. officials tracked many harm incidents involving U.S.-furnished weapons but took no further action, showing weak leverage use and incomplete control over a politically sensitive partner. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.7`, `8B.6`
- **US judge blocks latest Biden student debt relief plan** | Reuters | 2024-09-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/us-judge-blocks-latest-biden-student-debt-relief-plan-3603754 | Claim: A flagship domestic policy was blocked again by the courts, showing a major resistance point where the administration failed to keep the program advancing. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`, `8B.7`
- **Police were advised to avoid mass arrests, then came the US campus protests** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-10 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913 | Claim: The response to campus protests became coercive and overbroad, suggesting a politically charged control strategy that risked backlash rather than stabilizing the domestic environment. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.6`
- **Biden leaks and inner circle polling** | Axios | 2024-07-11 | https://www.axios.com/2024/07/11/biden-leaks-inner-circle-polling | Claim: A shrinking circle of loyalists filtered bad news, weakening internal challenge and making it harder to manage the administration as a resilient decision system. | QIDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`

**Search gap**
- Public evidence is much stronger on **foreign-policy crisis management** and **formal institutional actions** than on explicit personnel purges or deliberate replacement of ineffective implementers.
- The clearest failures are concentrated in **campaign control**, **court resistance**, and **Gaza accountability**, not in a documented, systematic inability to issue directives.
